dim_frm 2
dim_flt 7
wait 2000
findframe 0, "DESTINATION"
findframe 1, "Tommy"
mission_objectives 10
subtitle_add 10
detector_waitforuse 20
mission_objectivesremove 10
mission_objectives 30
subtitle_add 30
label 10
frm_getworldpos 0, 0
frm_getworldpos 1, 3
vect_sub_vect 0, 3
vect_magnitude 0, 6
if flt[6] < 2.5, 20, -1
wait 100
goto 10
label 20
mission_objectivesremove 30
subtitle_add 40
console_addtext 40
wait 4000
end

dim_frm 2
dim_flt 10
dim_act 3
wait 2000
label 1
detector_issignal -1, 2, -1
wait 100
goto 1
label 2
findactor 2, "Next"
findframe 0, "DESTINATION"
findframe 1, "Tommy"
mission_objectives 30
subtitle_add 30
findactor 0, "Guard"
findactor 1, "Tommy"
getgametime 8
autosavegamefull 5050, 1
label 10
human_getproperty 0, 7, Energy
if flt[7] > 0, -1, 30
getgametime 9
let flt[9] = flt[9] - flt[8]
if flt[9] > 15000, 30, -1
human_isweapon 1, 6, 23
if flt[6] = 1, -1, 15
frm_getworldpos 0, 0
frm_getworldpos 1, 3
vect_sub_vect 0, 3
vect_magnitude 0, 6
if flt[6] < 2.5, 20, -1
label 15
wait 100
goto 10
label 20
human_delweapon 1, 23
mission_objectivesremove 30
subtitle_add 40
console_addtext 40
wait 4000
detector_setsignal 2, 1
end
label 30
mission_objectivesremove 30
subtitle_add 50
console_addtext 50
wait 4000
endofmission 0, 50
end

dim_act 2
dim_flt 1
wait 2000
mission_objectives 10
subtitle_add 10
detector_waitforuse 20
findactor 0, "First"
findactor 1, "Second"
label 10
human_getproperty 0, 0, Energy
if flt[0] > 0, 40, -1
human_getproperty 1, 0, Energy
if flt[0] > 0, 40, -1
goto 20
label 40
wait 100
goto 10
label 20
mission_objectivesremove 10
subtitle_add 30
console_addtext 30
wait 4000
end

dim_act 3
dim_flt 3
wait 2000
label 1
detector_issignal -1, 2, -1
wait 100
goto 1
label 2
label 3
detector_inrange 0, 3
if flt[0] > 0, 4, -1
wait 100
goto 3
label 4
mission_objectives 10
subtitle_add 10
findactor 0, "First"
findactor 1, "Second"
findactor 2, "Guard"
getgametime 1
autosavegamefull 5050, 1
label 10
human_getproperty 2, 0, Energy
if flt[0] > 0, -1, 30
getgametime 2
let flt[2] = flt[2] - flt[1]
if flt[2] > 10000, 30, -1
human_getproperty 0, 0, Energy
if flt[0] > 0, 40, -1
human_getproperty 1, 0, Energy
if flt[0] > 0, 40, -1
goto 20
label 40
wait 100
goto 10
label 20
mission_objectivesremove 10
subtitle_add 30
console_addtext 30
wait 4000
endofmission 1, 30
end
label 30
mission_objectivesremove 10
subtitle_add 40
console_addtext 40
wait 4000
endofmission 0, 40
end
